headline: Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy Erupt in Violent Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline combat has surged to fever pitch across the central sectors, led by violent upheavals in the Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy. The Palantine Berm recorded thirteen base transitions in the past two hours alone, with fierce engagements swirling around Vendett, Windburn Landing, and the Pippeli Stones. In the Linn of Mercy, active base contention reignited with five fresh ownership changes and severe casualties, absorbing more than thirty-three hundred fallen soldiers over the two-hour interval as fighting battered Outwich Ranch and Lathair. The Weathered Expanse remained intensely contested with seven recent turnovers and mounting casualties leaving strategic strongpoints leveled in no-man's-land. Farther west, the Nevish Line maintained heavy attritional pressure around Grief Mother and Blinding Stones, whereas Marban Hollow and Gutter saw base movements taper off after earlier skirmishes. Peripheral sectors and interior rear hexes across both northern and southern territories continue to report complete quiet.
